title: Instagram will limit unlabeled AI-generated profiles
friendlyTitle: Instagram wants fake AI people to be clearly labeled
summary: Instagram is renaming its label for synthetic personas to “AI-generated profile” and says accounts that fail to self-label may lose recommendations in Reels and Explore. The rule applies to profiles presenting an AI-generated person, not every account that uses AI-made content.
friendlySummary: Instagram will reduce the reach of profiles that pretend an AI-made person is real and do not add the proper label.
whyItMatters: Synthetic personalities are becoming a routine media-literacy and brand-trust problem. Clearer labels should help users understand who—or what—they are following, while creators and marketers need to disclose synthetic personas or accept reduced reach.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This should make it easier to know when the person in a profile does not really exist. Businesses using virtual people need to label them clearly.
